instruction: How to configure tekton pipelines default timeout
output: kubectl patch configmap config-defaults -n tekton-pipelines --type merge -p '{"data":{"default-timeout":"30m"}}'

instruction: How to configure tekton pipelines default pod template
output: kubectl patch configmap config-defaults -n tekton-pipelines --type merge -p '{"data":{"default-pod-template":"{\"securityContext\":{\"runAsUser\":1000}}"}}'

instruction: How to enable tekton alpha features
output: kubectl patch configmap feature-flags -n tekton-pipelines --type merge -p '{"data":{"enable-api-fields":"alpha"}}'
